mapper.sql:
from data_reconcile_policy_t p join data_access_agg_task_t a on a.tid = p.access_task_id and a.tenant_id = p.tenant_id left join db_table_t st on st.tid = a.source_table_id and st.tenant_id = p.tenant_id left join db_table_t tt on tt.tid = a.target_table_id and tt.tenant_id = p.tenant_id left join data_reconcile_run_t r on r.tid = ( select latest.tid from ( select rr.tid, rr.policy_id, rr.tenant_id, row_number() over ( partition by rr.tenant_id, rr.policy_id order by rr.created_time desc ) row_no from data_reconcile_run_t rr ) latest where latest.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and latest.policy_id = p.tid and latest.row_no = 1 ) where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.is_del = 0
and ( p.policy_name like concat(concat('%', #{keyword}), '%') or a.task_name like concat(concat('%', #{keyword}), '%') or st.table_name like concat(concat('%', #{keyword}), '%') or tt.table_name like concat(concat('%', #{keyword}), '%') )
mapper.select:
select p.*, a.task_name, st.table_name source_table_name, tt.table_name target_table_name, r.status last_run_status, r.consistency_rate, r.diff_count last_diff_count, r.finished_at last_finished_at
order by p.updated_time desc

select p.*, a.task_name, a.source_db_id, a.source_table_id, a.target_db_id, a.target_table_id, st.table_name source_table_name, tt.table_name target_table_name, sd.db_name source_db_name, td.db_name target_db_name from data_reconcile_policy_t p join data_access_agg_task_t a on a.tid = p.access_task_id and a.tenant_id = p.tenant_id left join db_table_t st on st.tid = a.source_table_id and st.tenant_id = p.tenant_id left join db_table_t tt on tt.tid = a.target_table_id and tt.tenant_id = p.tenant_id left join db_datasource_t sd on sd.tid = a.source_db_id and sd.tenant_id = p.tenant_id left join db_datasource_t td on td.tid = a.target_db_id and td.tenant_id = p.tenant_id where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.tid = #{policyId} and p.is_del = 0

select r.*, p.policy_name, p.compare_mode, p.access_task_id from data_reconcile_run_t r join data_reconcile_policy_t p on p.tid = r.policy_id and p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.tid = #{runId}

select bucket_no, key_lower, key_upper, upper_inclusive, status, worker_id, source_count, target_count, matched_count, missing_target_count, extra_target_count, value_mismatch_count, diff_count, attempt, error_message, started_at, finished_at from data_reconcile_bucket_t where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and run_id = #{runId} order by bucket_no

select a.tid, a.task_name, a.source_db_id, a.source_table_id, a.target_db_id, a.target_table_id, a.source_table_primary_key, a.target_table_primary_key, a.source_table_increment_key, st.table_name source_table_name, tt.table_name target_table_name, sd.db_name source_db_name, td.db_name target_db_name from data_access_agg_task_t a join db_datasource_t sd on sd.tid = a.source_db_id and sd.tenant_id = a.tenant_id join db_datasource_t td on td.tid = a.target_db_id and td.tenant_id = a.tenant_id join db_table_t st on st.tid = a.source_table_id and st.tenant_id = a.tenant_id join db_table_t tt on tt.tid = a.target_table_id and tt.tenant_id = a.tenant_id where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.is_del = 0 and a.source_db_id is not null and a.source_table_id is not null and a.target_db_id is not null and a.target_table_id is not null order by a.updated_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into data_reconcile_policy_t( tid, tenant_id, policy_name, policy_code, access_task_id, compare_mode, trigger_mode, cron_expression, source_key_fields, target_key_fields, source_increment_field, target_increment_field, bucket_count, fetch_size, diff_limit, numeric_tolerance, null_equals_empty, trim_strings, ignore_case, status, precheck_status, version, remark, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, is_del ) values ( #{tid}, #{tenantId}, #{policyName}, #{policyCode}, #{accessTaskId}, #{compareMode}, #{triggerMode}, #{cronExpression}, #{sourceKeyFields}, #{targetKeyFields}, #{sourceIncrementField}, #{targetIncrementField}, #{bucketCount}, #{fetchSize}, #{diffLimit}, #{numericTolerance}, #{nullEqualsEmpty}, #{trimStrings}, #{ignoreCase}, 0, 'PENDING', 1, #{remark}, #{operator}, #{now}, #{operator}, #{now}, 0 )
mapper.update: update data_reconcile_policy_t set policy_name = #{policyName}, policy_code = #{policyCode}, access_task_id = #{accessTaskId}, compare_mode = #{compareMode}, trigger_mode = #{triggerMode}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, source_key_fields = #{sourceKeyFields}, target_key_fields = #{targetKeyFields}, source_increment_field = #{sourceIncrementField}, target_increment_field = #{targetIncrementField}, bucket_count = #{bucketCount}, fetch_size = #{fetchSize}, diff_limit = #{diffLimit}, numeric_tolerance = #{numericTolerance}, null_equals_empty = #{nullEqualsEmpty}, trim_strings = #{trimStrings}, ignore_case = #{ignoreCase}, status = 0, precheck_status = 'PENDING', precheck_message = null, precheck_detail = null, version = version + 1, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{operator}, updated_time = #{now} where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and tid = #{tid} and is_del = 0
mapper.insert: insert into data_reconcile_field_rule_t( tid, tenant_id, policy_id, source_field, target_field, source_data_type, target_data_type, compare_enabled, normalization, numeric_tolerance, date_precision, null_equals_empty, mask_rule, sort_no, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, is_del ) values ( #{tid}, #{tenantId}, #{policyId}, #{sourceField}, #{targetField}, #{sourceDataType}, #{targetDataType}, #{compareEnabled}, #{normalization}, #{numericTolerance}, #{datePrecision}, #{nullEqualsEmpty}, #{maskRule}, #{sortNo}, #{operator}, #{now}, #{operator}, #{now}, 0 )
mapper.select: select r.tid run_id, r.policy_id, r.lower_watermark, r.upper_watermark, p.compare_mode, p.source_key_fields, p.target_key_fields, p.source_increment_field, p.target_increment_field, p.fetch_size, p.diff_limit, p.numeric_tolerance, p.null_equals_empty, p.trim_strings, p.ignore_case, a.source_db_id, a.source_table_id, a.target_db_id, a.target_table_id from data_reconcile_run_t r join data_reconcile_policy_t p on p.tid = r.policy_id and p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id join data_access_agg_task_t a on a.tid = p.access_task_id and a.tenant_id = p.tenant_id where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.tid = #{runId}

select p.*, a.source_db_id, a.source_table_id, a.target_db_id, a.target_table_id from data_reconcile_policy_t p join data_access_agg_task_t a on a.tid = p.access_task_id and a.tenant_id = p.tenant_id where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.tid = #{policyId} and p.is_del = 0

select tid, tenant_id, cron_expression, next_run_at from data_reconcile_policy_t where is_del = 0 and status = 1 and trigger_mode = 'CRON' and (next_run_at is null or next_run_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) order by next_run_at
select tid from data_reconcile_policy_t where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and access_task_id = #{accessTaskId} and trigger_mode = 'ACCESS_EVENT' and status = 1 and is_del = 0
select count(1) from data_reconcile_diff_t where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and resolve_status = 'OPEN'

select d.tid datasource_id, d.jdbc_url, d.username, d.password, d.driver_class_name, d.db_type, d.database_type, t.tid table_id, t.table_name from db_datasource_t d join db_table_t t on t.datasource_id = d.tid and t.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and t.is_del = 0 where d.tid = #{datasourceId} and t.tid = #{tableId} and d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.is_del = 0 and d.is_enable = 1
